run_svm_experiment: run the sacred SVM experiment that trains on breast cancer data and returns test accuracy
create_svm_model: create an SVM classifier model with configurable C, gamma, and kernel parameters
configure_sacred_experiment: configure a sacred experiment with explicit dictionary config for SVM hyperparameters
add_file_observer: add a FileStorageObserver to a sacred experiment to log runs to a directory
load_and_split_data: load the breast cancer dataset and split into train and test sets with 20 percent test size
